description.value: Pre-specified regions included anterior temporal lobe, insular cortex, parietal cortex, and hippocampus in the right and left hemispheres.

spans.text: These regions were selected   a priori   based on functional neuroanatomical substrates of subjective time awareness identified in the healthy brain comprising anterior temporal lobe (the anterior parts of the superior, middle, inferior temporal, and fusiform gyri, and the temporal pole) ( 27 ,  79 – 81 ), insular cortex ( 2 ,  5 ,  13 ,  82 ), parietal cortex (inferior and superior parietal lobules, precuneus, and posterior cingulate cortex) ( 14 – 17 ,  83 ) and hippocampus ( 3 ,  19 ,  20 ).
